decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core pipeline-components business that uses existing customers, know-how and production assets, it is cheap to carry and still has option value unless clearly failing.

This public waste bin is relatively distant from the firm's core infrastructure offer, and after several years the uncertainty should be sufficiently resolved that resources are better redeployed to the stronger core business or nearer developments.

Although the waste-bin-with-ashtray line can use the firm's coating and fabrication capabilities, it remains commercially distant from the core range and its broader model variety raises the case for pruning if traction is not clearly strong by 2022.

Outdoor public ashtrays are a non-core municipal street-furniture product, so with multiple other product options available the firm is likely to refocus on nearer, more technically aligned offerings.
